name: Redbot
author: 4aikaman@gmail.com
description: Discord bot using discord.py with MongoDB. Entry: main.py. Uses requirements.txt only.
startup: if [[ -d .git ]] && [[ {{AUTO_UPDATE}} == "1" ]]; then git pull; fi; if [[ ! -z {{PY_PACKAGES}} ]]; then pip install -U --prefix .local {{PY_PACKAGES}}; fi; if [[ -f /home/container/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE} ]]; then pip install -U --prefix .local -r ${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}; fi; /usr/local/bin/python /home/container/{{BOT_PY_FILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Python Bot Installation Script for Redbot
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -e
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
  echo -e "User upload selected; skipping git clone."
  exit 0
fi

# Ensure .git suffix if missing
if [[ -n ${GIT_ADDRESS} ]] && [[ ${GIT_ADDRESS} != *.git ]]; then
  GIT_ADDRESS=${GIT_ADDRESS}.git
fi

if [ -n "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
  if [ -z "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -z "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
    echo -e "Cloning via anonymous access"
  else
    GIT_ADDRESS="https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@$(echo -e ${GIT_ADDRESS} | cut -d/ -f3-)"
  fi

  if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server || true)" ]; then
    echo -e "/mnt/server not empty."
    if [ -d .git ] && [ -f .git/config ]; then
      ORIGIN=$(git config --get remote.origin.url || echo "")
      if [ "${ORIGIN}" == "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo "Pulling latest from origin"
        git pull
      else
        echo "Existing repo does not match target; skipping pull."
      fi
    else
      echo "Directory has files but no git repo; leaving files untouched."
    fi
  else
    echo -e "/mnt/server is empty. Cloning files into repo"
    if [ -z ${BRANCH} ]; then
      git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    else
      git clone --single-branch --branch ${BRANCH} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
  fi
else
  echo "No GIT_ADDRESS provided. Expecting user upload or mounted files."
fi

export HOME=/mnt/server

echo "Installing Python requirements into container-local prefix"
if [[ -n ${PY_PACKAGES} ]]; then
  pip install -U --prefix .local ${PY_PACKAGES}
fi

if [ -f "/mnt/server/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}" ]; then
  pip install -U --prefix .local -r "${REQUIREMENTS_FILE}"
fi

echo -e "Install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description: Skip git install if user uploads files. 0 = false, 1 = true

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: git pull on startup if a git repo is present

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone. Blank = default branch

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Optional username for private repo access

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Use a Personal Access Token for private repos

variables.name: Bot py file
variables.description: Python file that starts the bot (relative to repo root)

variables.name: Create Channel IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated channel IDs that trigger private VC creation

variables.name: Default Channel Names
variables.description: Comma-separated list used to name new VCs (required)

variables.name: Allowed Guilds
variables.description: Comma-separated guild IDs the bot is allowed to stay in

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Python logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR)
